principles: Host-neutral authority: Lattice coordinates/verifies while external hosts execute only.
Visible supervised automation: missing CLIs, timeouts, failures, and policy choices must be explicit JSON/status output.
Fail-closed receipts: accepted-local is local diagnostic only and never productionDone.
Fake-runner first: deterministic local proof comes before live third-party CLI dependence.
Resumable lifecycle: every dispatch has inspectable status and recovery actions.
drivers: User wants another host to execute when current agent capacity is insufficient.
Real host CLIs vary in availability, flags, login state, and noninteractive execution support.
Existing Lattice gates require command policy, process facts, docs, and verification evidence for new workflow facts.

options.name: real-host-runner-first
pros: Feels closest to automatic Claude/Gemini execution
cons: Risk of confusing local CLI output with authority

options.name: protocol-and-fake-runner-first
cons: Live host execution is scaffolded, not fully dependent on installed CLIs

options.name: docs-only
cons: Does not satisfy dispatch_run implementation or validation request

rationale: Choose protocol-and-fake-runner-first because it delivers runnable dispatch_run behavior and test proof while keeping real-host variability supervised and non-authoritative.

preMortem.scenario: dispatch_run is mistaken for an authority runner
preMortem.trigger: Output says accepted or merge-ready without false/diagnostic fields
preMortem.consequence: External host output could be treated as DONE
preMortem.mitigation: Every output carries receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, authorityChanged=false, and manual nextAction.

preMortem.scenario: real host CLI is missing or hangs
preMortem.consequence: User sees a hard crash or hidden hang
preMortem.mitigation: Runtime probe detects missing commands, adapters emit unavailable/failed with timeout/status/transcript.

preMortem.scenario: host prose lies about changed files
preMortem.trigger: Collector trusts text output instead of git
preMortem.consequence: Denied or unrelated edits could be accepted
preMortem.mitigation: dispatch_collect derives changedFiles from git diff only; receipt validation checks pack hash/base/head/scope.

preMortem.scenario: test suite depends on Claude/Gemini login
preMortem.mitigation: Full smoke uses fake runner; real adapters are tested through metadata and unavailable degradation.

preMortem.consequence: Unreviewed external changes enter owner branch
preMortem.mitigation: merge_plan returns guidance only and never runs merge/cherry-pick.
